AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

3. C — newton (N)

4. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. C — Glucose and oxygen

6. B — Ice melting to water

7. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

8. D — Producers

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

11. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
